name: Flora and Sauna 2: Lost in Saunia
source:
It's time for the spa's annual cleaning, and what better way to kick off the vacation time than a game of Swords and Sorcery? As the shrinking magic kicks in, the spa gang realizes they're in for much more than a simple tabletop game. Join your favorite Flora & Sauna characters on a kinky fantasy adventure as they discover the world of Saunia and the dangers of their own character sheets.

[From [url=https://obcerd.itch.io/lost-in-saunia-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
